format: html

---


```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```
```{r}

ggplot(income_tx) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "viridis",
    name = "Median household income",
    labels = scales::label_dollar()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income by County in Texas",
    subtitle = "2020 American Community Survey",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

```


```{r}
#| message: false

edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c(
    total = "B15003_001",
    bachelors = "B15003_022",
    masters = "B15003_023",
    professional = "B15003_024",
    doctorate = "B15003_025"
  ),
  summary_var = "B15003_001",
  year = 2020
)
```






```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 8

edu_state %>%
  filter(variable %in% c(
    "bachelors",
    "masters",
    "professional",
    "doctorate"
  )) %>%
  group_by(GEOID, NAME) %>%
  summarize(
    percent_bachelors_higher =
      sum(estimate, na.rm = TRUE) / first(summary_est),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = percent_bachelors_higher,
    y = reorder(NAME, percent_bachelors_higher)
  )) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", width = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1),
    name = "Adults with a bachelor's degree or higher",
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Educational Attainment by State",
    subtitle = "Percentage of adults with a bachelor's degree or higher, 2020",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 American Community Survey"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9)
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false

age_ca <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = c(
    median_age = "B01002_001",
    population = "B01003_001"
  ),
  state = "CA",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = FALSE
)
```






```{r}
#| message: false

age_ca %>%
  select(NAME, variable, estimate) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = variable,
    values_from = estimate
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = population, y = median_age)) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_text(
    data = function(x) {
      x %>% slice_max(population, n = 5)
    },
    aes(label = NAME),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 3,
    check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(
    labels = scales::label_comma(),
    name = "County population (log scale)",
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.35))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "County Population and Median Age in California",
    subtitle = "2020 American Community Survey",
    y = "Median age (years)",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 40, 5.5, 5.5)
  )
```
